extracted.intended_audience: prospective improv students and theatergoers (people seeking improv classes and full-length unscripted shows)
extracted.subtask_description: Constructing and performing completely improvised, full-length plays in the styles of established playwrights/genres, and training actors and non-actors in that approach. Emphasis on research, ensemble skill, storytelling, and a supportive classroom environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fully improvised, full-length plays
rubrics_metrics.description: Impro Theatre's shows are completely improvised, full-length plays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performances contain no script and sustain a full-length play format; the company constructs entire plays on the spot rather than short-form games or sketches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style emulation of established playwrights/authors/composers
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows are performed "in the styles of the world’s greatest playwrights, authors and composers."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performances aim to evoke recognizable authorial or genre characteristics rather than generic improv; fidelity to a target style is an explicit creative goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extensive research and rehearsal per author/genre
rubrics_metrics.description: Performers and faculty "research, study and rehearse each new author or genre for months, learning everything there is to know about it before taking the stage."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preparation is prolonged and scholarly — studying conventions, voice, structure and tropes of the target author/genre before performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional performer/faculty credentials and experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Performers and faculty are "professional actors, writers and directors with decades of experience in theatre, television, film and improv."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level professional background and long experience are presented as necessary for the company’s style of long-form narrative improvisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verbal dexterity / rapid creative writing on stage
rubrics_metrics.description: They combine "verbal dexterity" and are praised for being able to "write on their feet better than many writers can type at a desk."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fast, witty, and precise language use is a core evaluative dimension for performers — improvisational writing skill is central to success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robust physicality
rubrics_metrics.description: Performers combine verbal skill with "robust physicality."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical performance and embodiment are emphasized alongside verbal improvisation to create character and theatricality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediacy: bring character and story to life instantly
rubrics_metrics.description: Performers bring "character and story to life in an instant."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to rapidly establish character, relationship, and narrative stakes without rehearsal or script is a key performance standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uniqueness and distinct theatrical experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Impro Theatre performance is described as "unique and unlike any other theatrical experience."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Originality of each show — no two performances repeat — is an explicit quality claim and evaluative axis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Welcoming, non-competitive, non-judgmental learning environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Students find a "welcoming, exciting, non competitive, non judgemental and joyful environment to learn."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pedagogical standard stresses emotional safety and positive culture as necessary conditions for learning improv, for both actors and non-actors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teach fundamentals of improv, storytelling, and authentic unscripted play performance
rubrics_metrics.description: The school teaches "fundamental improv, storytelling and performing unscripted plays in an authentic way."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction focuses on narrative structure, character work, and techniques for sustaining authentic unscripted long-form plays (not just short-form games).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unique approach to unscripted storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Impro Theatre School teaches "our unique approach to unscripted storytelling to both actors and non-actors alike."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program positions its curriculum and methods as distinctive; students are trained in a particular institutional methodology for narrative improv.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construct narrative improv inspired by influential genres and authors
rubrics_metrics.description: The company specializes in "constructing fully improvised plays inspired by the works of influential genres, playwrights, and authors."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on narrative construction (as opposed to disparate scenes) and on deriving inspiration from known genre/author conventions to shape improvised stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational longevity and reputation as quality indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: "37 Years of Unscripted Theatre" and press quotes (LA Times, Stage Raw, etc.) highlight reputation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Longevity, nonprofit mission, and critical praise are presented as evidence of artistic quality and institutional credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Range of production pathways (student, guest, professional shows)
rubrics_metrics.description: The company offers "Student Shows, Guest Shows, Impro Theatre Professional Shows."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple tiers of production indicate opportunities for training-to-stage progression and varied performance contexts; quality expectations may differ by pathway but all are part of the ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daring/high-risk theatrical performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews call the work a "true high-wire act literally beyond belief" and "a feat that expands the definition of human potential."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Risk-taking, bold theatrical choices, and virtuosity are implied standards — shows are evaluated for daring and technical virtuosity in live improvisation.
